_comment: Optional --map file for: node scripts/importDataset.js --type rooms --file <csv> --map import-mappings/rooms.json
`columns` maps an exact CSV header (as it appears in your file) to a Room schema field, and takes precedence over the built-in header synonyms below.
`defaults` fills a field for every row whose CSV cell is blank. --department/--year/--semester/--academicYear CLI flags don't apply here, Room has none of those fields.
Built-in header synonyms (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive; see utils/importNormalizers.js HEADER_SYNONYMS.rooms) — no --map needed if your headers already match one of these:
roomno, room, roomname, name -> name (required, upsert key with building)
building -> building (required, upsert key with name)

roomtype, type -> type (lecture_hall|lab|seminar_room|auditorium; lecture/classroom/lh/lecturehall -> lecture_hall, lab/laboratory/computerlab/complab -> lab, seminar/seminarroom -> seminar_room, auditorium/hall -> auditorium, anything else -> lecture_hall; blank uses lecture_hall on insert and leaves the stored value untouched on update)

features, equipment, facilities -> equipment (split on , ; |, lowercased; synonyms: projector/lcd -> projector, smartboard/"smart board"/"interactive board" -> smartboard, ac/"air conditioning" -> ac, computers/pcs -> computers)

availability -> availability (free text, e.g. "Mon-Fri 09:00-17:30" or "Mon 09:00-12:00; Tue 14:00-17:00"; unparseable defaults to Mon-Fri 09:00-17:30, weekends empty; a blank cell uses that default on insert and leaves the stored value untouched on update)
